hab: Data centres the size of towns
bio: A gecko hatchling with one glowing scale on its back. It sticks to warm walls and hums when it thinks.
A lizard whose back spines glow like a row of cards. It runs hot, so it is always looking for a fan.
A great lizard that rolls a glowing die before every move. The fans along its back roar when it attacks; the lights in town dim.
note: Every scale it grows is worth more than the last one.
Sells the same spine to everyone, and everyone queues.
Its value doubled while you read this.
